plugins.name: OmniFlow
plugins.description: Android GUI automation powered by the OmniFlow VLM runtime.

description.zh: OmniFlow 运行时和 GUI/VLM 操作模块默认启用；首次使用手机操作前，请确认无障碍服务和 Agent Provider 已配置。
description.en: The OmniFlow runtime and GUI/VLM operation module are enabled by default; configure accessibility and an Agent Provider before the first phone task.

description.zh: 插件包统一管理 OmniFlow、OmniTransfer、模型 checkpoint 和 Python 依赖，并在安装或更新阶段校验版本与契约。
description.en: The plugin package manages OmniFlow, OmniTransfer, the model checkpoint, and Python dependencies, verifying versions and contracts during install or update.

description.zh: 运行时和操作工具默认启用；需要手机操作时，确认无障碍服务和 Agent Provider 已就绪即可。
description.en: The runtime and operation tools are enabled by default; confirm accessibility and an Agent Provider are ready before phone tasks.

title.zh: 只增加一个轻量基线包

description.zh: 内置运行包让首次使用无需单独下载；操作流程的注册、复用和执行由可更新的 OmniFlow 插件提供。
description.en: The bundled runtime avoids a separate first-use download. The updatable OmniFlow plugin handles registration, reuse, and execution of saved operations.

Canonical RunLog.zh: 查看任务执行的每一步
Canonical RunLog.en: Review every step of a task

RunLog to Function.zh: 把成功操作保存下来重复使用

Function recall and parameter binding.zh: 相似任务自动找到流程并替换新内容
Function recall and parameter binding.en: Find a matching flow and substitute new details

Function replay with OmniTransfer.zh: 换一台手机也能找到对应按钮并执行
Function replay with OmniTransfer.en: Adapt saved actions to another phone

Mobilerun Manager and Executor.zh: 管理并执行已保存的手机操作
Mobilerun Manager and Executor.en: Manage and run saved phone actions

OmniFlow Python runtime.zh: 需要高级能力时自动准备运行环境
OmniFlow Python runtime.en: Prepare advanced automation only when needed

plugins.name: Vibe Builder
plugins.description: Build standalone phone-first Apps linked to Xiaowan, isolated data, and reusable backend connectors.

description.zh: 启用后，Agent 可以生成带独立 HTML 界面和 SVG 桌面图标的小 App，并快速连接小万、可调用工具与隔离数据；发布后作为独立插件管理。
description.en: Enable the Agent to generate a standalone HTML App with an SVG home-screen icon, then link Xiaowan, callable tools, and isolated data behind it as an independent plugin.

plugins.name: OmniLink 协作工具箱
plugins.description: Give Xiaowan a bounded toolbox for collaborating with Xiaowan on another trusted device over the local OmniLink gateway.
capabilities: Compose remote battery and device-readiness queries
Read and subscribe to Agent-safe event types

description.zh: 让小万在聊天中直接组合 OmniLink 原语：查询另一台手机的电量和在线状态，订阅隐私安全的事件摘要，给另一台设备上的小万发信号，并自动把事件回流当前会话。
description.en: Let Xiaowan compose OmniLink primitives from chat: query another phone's battery and reachability, subscribe to privacy-safe event summaries, signal another Xiaowan, and surface events in the current conversation.

description.zh: 说“列出协作设备”，小万会读取设备 readiness，再按你的意图组合查询。
description.en: Say “list collaboration devices”; Xiaowan reads readiness and composes the requested query.

description.zh: 说“查另一台手机的电量和是否在线”，小万会读取实时 readiness。
description.en: Say “check the other phone's battery and reachability”; Xiaowan reads live readiness.

description.zh: 说“开始接收另一台手机的通知”，通知会持续回流当前聊天，正文按隐私策略隐藏。
description.en: Say “start receiving notifications from the other phone”; safe summaries return to this chat while content stays private.

title.zh: 小万自己组合事件订阅

description.zh: 说“开始接收另一台手机的通知”，小万会选择安全事件类型并建立持续回流。
description.en: Say “start receiving notifications from the other phone”; Xiaowan selects safe event types and starts the stream.

title.zh: 让两个小万互相发信号

description.zh: 说“给另一台设备上的小万发消息：……”；消息带幂等 ID，可安全重试。
description.en: Say “send a message to the other Xiaowan: …”; messages carry an idempotency ID and can be retried safely.

description.zh: 另一台设备的 Agent 消息和事件摘要会自动回到当前聊天，不需要用户复制 CLI 输出。
description.en: Agent messages and notification events from the other device return to the current chat without copying CLI output.

steps.zh: 回到聊天，说“列出协作设备”。
steps.en: Return to chat and say “List collaboration devices.”

steps.zh: 再说“给设备 <device_id> 上的小万发消息：请回复 READY”。
steps.en: Then say “Send to device <device_id>: reply READY.”

steps.zh: 对方事件会作为一条 OmniLink 协作消息出现在聊天中。
steps.en: The peer event appears as an OmniLink collaboration message in chat.

Read device readiness.zh: 读取设备状态与能力就绪度

Send idempotent Agent messages.zh: 向另一个小万发送可重试消息

Subscribe to Agent message events.zh: 订阅另一台设备的小万消息
